articles.title: A Baseball-Sized Robot That Turns Into a Moon Rover
articles.summary: SORA-Q, a toy-inspired rover about the size of a baseball, transformed on the moon and photographed its lander's touchdown for more than 90 minutes.

articles.title: A Visitor From Another Star Is Made of Dusty Ice
articles.summary: The James Webb Space Telescope found that interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS is built from tiny, dust-rich ice grains unlike those in our solar system's comets.

articles.title: An Antarctic Island Looks Like a Skull, and Its Ice Is Telling a Story
articles.summary: NASA satellite images show Vega Island's skull-like shape, and far less snow in October 2026 than in March 2025, a warning sign for its glaciers.
